results.scope: Points and lines of PG(2,13) are both elements of Mathlib's Projectivization (ZMod 13) (Fin 3 -> ZMod 13); a point lies on a line when the dot product of representatives vanishes (Projectivization.orthogonal). singer is the projectivity of the matrix of multiplication by theta on F_13[theta]/(theta^3 + theta + 6) in the basis 1, theta, theta^2, and hgen = singer^[61]. HInvariant B says hgen maps B into B; IsBlocking B says B meets every line; CapAtMost B c says every line meets B in at most c points (Set.ncard). admissibleCaps is the set of c for which an H-invariant blocking set with CapAtMost c exists.
The Singer cycle has order exactly 183, hgen^[3] is the identity, and hgen fixes no point of PG(2,13).

Every point is the point of theta^i for some i < 183; the line lineVec s consists of the points theta^(d+s), d in D. For an arbitrary H-invariant set B the intersection with lineVec s has rowCount points, and an H-invariant blocking set with all intersections at most 4 yields a solution of the 61-variable system with orbit 0 chosen. Only the 61 lines lineVec s, s < 61, are used for the lower bound; no size or minimality assumption is made on B.

go is a depth-first search evaluated by the kernel with decide +kernel. Its steps are checked against rowCount; go_sound holds for every value of the heuristic plan and the packed counts. The top search from the root (orbit 0 chosen) is cut at 342 partial assignments, each closed by a separate kernel-checked search in SingerC3.Cert.Part00 to Part15; together they take 771752 steps.

The 21-point set is H-invariant, blocking, meets every line in at most five points, meets some line in exactly five points, has 21 points and is a minimal blocking set. Its conjugacy to the set of Blokhuis, Brouwer and Wilbrink is checked by certificate/check_singer.py, not in Lean.
No H-invariant blocking set meets every line in at most four points; every H-invariant blocking set meets some line in at least five points; and IsLeast admissibleCaps 5.
Conventional proof (Section 5): every fixed-point-free collineation of order three generates a conjugate of H. Not formalized.
